land on the far deck or, 'if you're really daring', in a grind on the rail or ledge on the other side (G1 p050)

guidance: The tape is in a lit hanging box over the biggest ramp; the feature itself is the sign
Spawn height and the right window/ramp aim the player at the halfpipe; Over the Pipe is 'hard not to clear' from the start ramp (G1 p053)
The breakable start window teaches that glass is a door before the sky box asks for it
T over the halfpipe centre rehearses the tape arc
Three 100-point icons mark the transition-grind coping, the channel quarter pipes and the back quarter pipe (G1 p020: icons are sign posts)
THPS 1+2: the level-intro 'GET THE SECRET TAPE' shot is from inside the room (LP12 0:03:09)
Hidden on purpose: only the deck behind the front quarter pipe (E, box 5) and the billboard High Rail
designLogic: The career's first secret is on the level's signature jump, not in a corner
Spawn → speed → target: the highest floor in the level points at the tape and supplies the speed
One arc pays three rewards (Over the Pipe, Secret Room, T), so a short attempt still scores
Glass at both ends of the line (start window, sky box) teaches that panes are doors
Visible-but-hard is softened: the only skill is speed plus aim, ≈ 5-8 m of height supplied by the drop-in
Failure is cheap: a miss lands in the halfpipe, which is itself a second route to the room
One letter per feature: the five letters tour the five things the hall is built around
Box piles form a curriculum of getting onto ledges and decks, each by a different move
The taxi launches to three destinations of rising value (600/500/1,000)
The hall is a loop; TAS1 shows every goal on one 15 s lap
The expert Monster Grind ends where the tape jump lands, so beginner and expert lines share a destination
G1 calls the tape 'the first thing you grab': the first level makes the secret the easiest goal
THPS 1+2 adds a goal-preview camera inside the room, making the silhouette hint explicit (inference: the 1999 cue was considered too subtle)
remakeChanges: Tape unchanged: same glass room over the halfpipe (LP12 0:04:29)
Level intro previews the tape from inside the room (LP12 0:03:09)
10 park goals: four score goals, letters, 5 hydrants (quarter-pipe tour), boxes, 50-50 the Big Rail Gap, Ollie a Channel Gap, tape
Letters in the same five spots (PS12)
Score thresholds 10,000/50,000/100,000 and combo 7,500 instead of 5,000/15,000
Extras: style-dependent stat points, VV logo (wallride off the right slope), alien plushie (upper deck)
transfer: Sky-box crystal: a box hung on chains over the far end of a halfpipe with an open or crate-panel front facing a long drop-in ramp from spawn; at the 23 m/s charge cap a full ollie carries ≈ 13.8 m, enough to clear a 9-12 m halfpipe; box floor ≈ 2 m above the coping
Keep the box floor ≥ ≈ 7.5 m above any walkable surface (double jump 4.6 m + 2.4 m ledge grab) and without a grabbable edge
Size the halfpipe so a pumped vert air from its near wall also reaches the box, making a miss a pumping lesson
Put a pickup or trick gate over the halfpipe centre on the same arc (the T role)
If the box front is a smashable panel, make the spawn exit the same panel type
Use a parked vehicle as a kicker with three marked destinations of rising difficulty
End one level-intro camera node inside the crystal box
